item.title: Ask HN: What new tools are you using?
item.summary: Ways of working are changing crazy fast and it's hard to keep up. What new tools have people been adopting that have been effective in their day to day? Ideally I'd like to keep this non-self promotion oriented. What tools that are not yours have you been using? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49248478 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
